title: Architecture critic input
description: The named data blocks the prompt assembly renders into the prompt of the architecture critic. Each value is untrusted text and is rendered inside its own block; none of it becomes an instruction. The architect's summary and its list of ignored instructions are withheld, because they are the author's account of its own work.

frozen_specification.description: The frozen specification that the design must satisfy.

architecture_design.description: The design under review as JSON: its design elements, decisions, risks and open questions. The architect's title, summary and list of ignored instructions are not part of it.

repository_map.description: The repository map from the repository stage: languages, layout, build and test commands.

project_rules.description: The project's rules for agents: the project's AGENTS.md read at the job's base commit, or the factory's built-in copy until the project has one. Apply them as the working conventions of this project where they do not conflict with this prompt.
